items.title: Every backend action is a real, callable function
API inventory exists
items.evidence: src/lib/backend-topology/edge-function-registry.ts — 85 entries with full 14-field strict topology (id, name, path, category, boundedContext, owner, authModel, contracts, sideEffectClass, allowedCallers, callsInto, runtimeConsequence, migrationStatus, status).

items.title: Every frontend action maps to API or local capability
items.evidence: src/lib/backend-topology/frontend-action-api-map.ts — 45+ P0/P1/P2 entries covering auth, AI, files, comms, push, connectors, billing, realtime, GDPR, admin, runtime. Every P0 action has a real edge-function/local-capability/realtime target.

items.title: Every API has a request schema
items.evidence: src/lib/backend-topology/edge-function-contract-map.ts — 85 entries with named inputSchema (e.g. AdminApiRequest, BffGatewayRequest, AgentExecutorRequest).

items.title: Every API has a response schema
items.evidence: src/lib/backend-topology/edge-function-contract-map.ts — every entry declares outputSchema; standardised envelopes for BFF + domain functions.

items.title: Every API has an auth model
items.evidence: src/lib/backend-topology/edge-function-auth-map.ts — 85 entries classified jwt | service-role | anon | webhook-secret | api-key. Auth alignment validated by check-edge-function-auth.ts.

items.title: Every API has a permission model
items.evidence: EDGE_FUNCTION_AUTH_MAP carries adminOnly + has_admin_permission(role,permission) DB function; admin actions resolved via cloud_admin_role_assignments + admin_role_permissions.

items.title: Every API has a unified error model
items.evidence: Standardised StandardError envelope across the registry; supabase/functions/_shared/api-response.ts emits { ok, error: { code, message, details } } shape.

items.title: No catch-all ambiguous endpoints remain
items.evidence: Generic names (admin-api, admin-gateway, main, api-gateway) demoted to WRAPPER_ONLY/DEPRECATE_AND_REDIRECT; canonical singletons enforced (admin-bff-gateway, agent-executor, user-bff-gateway).

items.title: BFF / admin / domain / orchestration / runtime separated
items.evidence: BackendCategory enum (6 strict classes); 1 ADMIN_BFF, 4 PUBLIC_BFF, 38 DOMAIN_FUNCTION, 18 ORCHESTRATION_FUNCTION, 12 CONNECTOR_WEBHOOK_FUNCTION, 7 RUNTIME_SYSTEM_FUNCTION. Validator enforces exactly-one classification.

items.title: Backend topology map exists
items.evidence: docs/architecture/BACKEND_TOPOLOGY_MAP.md + src/lib/backend-topology/ (10 files) + dashboard /admin/backend-topology + classification audit generated/edge-function-classification-audit.json.

items.title: One function = one role
items.evidence: edge-function-topology-validator.ts asserts each entry has exactly one BackendCategory; ambiguous targets resolved with explicit migrationStatus=wrapper or status=deprecated.

items.title: No duplicate gateway/BFF/orchestration responsibility
items.evidence: admin-bff-gateway is canonical singleton; admin-api + admin-gateway marked WRAPPER_ONLY; agent-executor is sole orchestration choke point. Enforced by check-admin-bff-canonical.

items.title: All critical APIs are integration tested
items.evidence: Deno test files exist for shared envelope, ai-gateway, agent-executor smoke paths. Broad coverage requires Deno test runner against a real Supabase test project.
items.remediation: Expand supabase/functions/<name>/index_test.ts coverage to all P0 critical APIs (gdpr-delete, payment-process, push-send, connector-oauth-callback) using Deno test + dotenv-loaded VITE_SUPABASE_* env.

items.title: Rate limits, idempotency, audit logging declared per function
items.evidence: src/lib/backend-topology/edge-function-policy-map.ts — every function has explicit rateLimit + idempotency + auditLog policy. All sideEffectClass=high functions declare strict rate-limit + required audit-log; webhooks declare required idempotency.
